findings.summary: T14 only covers the positive (enable) branch. Nothing in this unit spec checks that a negative deltaQty maps to BILLING_EVENTS.ADDON_DISABLED with a negative amountDelta, or that the FOR UPDATE lock is taken on d.tenantId.
findings.scenario: Suppose someone flips the ternary so deltaQty < 0 emits ADDON_ENABLED, or drops the sign from the amount. addon-ledger.spec.ts stays green. Only the call-site tests T10/T13 (FIX-865B/C) would catch it.

findings.summary: The guard skips only a null snapshot. A stored 0 snapshot on a paying tenant still emits an ADDON_ENABLED/ADDON_DISABLED event with amountDelta 0. The spec comment calls null 'a free grant, D1', but addon.service.spec.ts:516 says D1 writes 0 for a free grant, so the two disagree on how D1 is represented.
findings.scenario: An admin grants a free add-on (priceSnapshot 0 under D1) to an ACTIVE/PRODUCTION tenant. A billing.event row is written with amountDelta 0. The ledger math is unaffected. This is audit noise, or intended audit, depending on the ruling. It needs a one-line decision, not a code change.
